name: ui-forge
description: A VS Code integrated D2C agent for React projects.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ui-forge/shared-protocol && npm run build -w @ui-forge/client-core && npm run build -w @ui-forge/codex-client
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @ui-forge/agent-server && npm run build -w @ui-forge/agent-webview && npm run build -w @ui-forge/vscode-extension && npm run build -w @ui-forge/agent-cli
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ui-forge/agent-server && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build:apps
